title: 12 C.N.C. § 12-201.7 — Appointments, Confirmation By Legislature
text:
APPOINTMENTS, CONFIRMATION BY LEGISLATURE.
Any person who is deemed desirable, appropriate and competent to fulfill the functions of
the office or position for which the person is being considered, may be appointed by the Governor,
subject to the consent of the Legislature. Other such requirements or limitations as may be included

(Updated 8/24/01)

Governor
by legislative act or by the Constitution shall also be considered by the Governor in making such
appointments and by the Legislature in confirming such appointments. (TL6-007, 5/20/89)
